description: The plot illustrates the Similarity across different Layers for four conditions: en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The en&en condition is represented by a solid dark red line without markers. It begins at a Similarity of approximately 0.07 at Layer 0, rises to a prominent peak of roughly 0.26 at Layer 6, and then drops to about 0.16 at Layer 7. It experiences a secondary, broader peak of approximately 0.18 at Layer 12 before declining to a low of about 0.08 at Layer 20, finally rising sharply to end at approximately 0.43 at Layer 23. The en&es condition is shown as a solid light blue line with no markers. It starts at approximately 0.06 at Layer 0, peaks at roughly 0.24 at Layer 6, and falls to about 0.15 at Layer 7. The line then rises to a secondary peak of approximately 0.17 at Layer 12, declines to a low of roughly 0.05 at Layer 20, and ends with a sharp increase to approximately 0.27 at Layer 23. The en&el condition is depicted by a solid light green line without markers. It begins at roughly 0.04 at Layer 0, reaches a small peak of about 0.08 at Layer 2, and then a larger peak of approximately 0.15 at Layer 6. After dropping to about 0.10 at Layer 7, it rises to roughly 0.14 at Layer 12, declines to a trough of approximately 0.04 between Layers 18 and 20, and sharply increases to end at about 0.30 at Layer 23. The en&bn condition is represented by a solid light purple line with no markers. It starts at approximately 0.03 at Layer 0, shows a minor peak of about 0.07 at Layer 2, and reaches a larger peak of roughly 0.14 at Layer 6. It then decreases to about 0.09 at Layer 7, rises to approximately 0.13 at Layer 12, falls to a low of roughly 0.04 between Layers 18 and 20, and concludes with a sharp rise to approximately 0.29 at Layer 23.
